instances.name: storage-scanner
instances.user_data:
#!/bin/bash
# User data script for Storage & Scanner Instance
# Runs Minio (S3-compatible) and Clair in Docker containers
# THREAT INJECTION: T05, T08, T11

set -e

echo "Starting storage and scanner setup..."

# Update system
yum update -y

# Install Docker
amazon-linux-extras install docker -y
systemctl start docker
systemctl enable docker

echo "Starting Minio and Clair containers..."

# Run Minio (S3-compatible object storage)
# T05: Public bucket access
# T08: Hardcoded credentials
# T03: HTTP instead of HTTPS
docker run -d \
  --name minio \
  --restart always \
  -p 9000:9000 \
  -p 9001:9001 \
  -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=minioadmin \
  -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=minioadmin123 \
  -v minio-data:/data \
  minio/minio:latest \
  server /data --console-address ":9001"

# Wait for Minio to start
sleep 10

# Create bucket and set public policy
# T05: Anonymous bucket access
docker run --rm \
  --network host \
  minio/mc:latest \
  sh -c "mc alias set myminio http://localhost:9000 minioadmin minioadmin123 && \
         mc mb myminio/quay-images --ignore-existing && \
         mc anonymous set download myminio/quay-images"

# Run Clair vulnerability scanner
# T03: Unencrypted database connection
# T08: Hardcoded credentials
# T11: No authentication on API
mkdir -p /opt/clair/config

cat > /opt/clair/config/config.yaml <<EOF
http_listen_addr: :6060
introspection_addr: :6061
log_level: info

indexer:
  connstring: host=10.0.0.76 port=5432 dbname=quay user=quayuser password=insecure_password_123 sslmode=disable
  scanlock_retry: 10
  layer_scan_concurrency: 5
  migrations: true

matcher:
  connstring: host=10.0.0.76 port=5432 dbname=quay user=quayuser password=insecure_password_123 sslmode=disable
  max_conn_pool: 100
  migrations: true

notifier:
  connstring: host=10.0.0.76 port=5432 dbname=quay user=quayuser password=insecure_password_123 sslmode=disable
  migrations: true

# T11: No authentication
auth:
  psk:
    key: ""
    iss: ["quay"]
EOF

docker run -d \
  --name clair \
  --restart always \
  -p 6060:6060 \
  -p 6061:6061 \
  -v /opt/clair/config:/etc/clair:Z \
  quay.io/projectquay/clair:latest

echo "Storage and scanner services started" >> /var/log/storage-startup.log

instances.name: llm-service
instances.user_data:
#!/bin/bash
# User data script for LLM Service
# THREAT INJECTION: T11-T17

set -e

echo "Starting LLM service setup..."

# Update system
yum update -y

# Install Python 3.9 and development tools
yum install -y python3 python3-pip git gcc gcc-c++ make

# Install llama-cpp-python
pip3 install llama-cpp-python[server]

# Create models directory
mkdir -p /opt/llm/models

# T14: Download model over HTTP (insecure)
# T11: Model publicly accessible
cd /opt/llm/models
wget -q https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/orca_mini_3B-GGUF/resolve/main/orca-mini-3b.q4_0.gguf -O orca-mini-3b.gguf

# T17: Model metadata exposed in config
cat > /opt/llm/model-info.json <<EOF
{
  "model_name": "orca-mini-3b",
  "model_path": "/opt/llm/models/orca-mini-3b.gguf",
  "parameters": "3B",
  "quantization": "q4_0",
  "context_length": 2048,
  "download_url": "https://huggingface.co/TheBloke/orca_mini_3B-GGUF",
  "api_port": 8000,
  "authentication": "none"
}
EOF

# T16: No model provenance tracking
# T15: Service has broad IAM permissions

# Create systemd service for LLM server
cat > /etc/systemd/system/llm-service.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=LLM Inference Service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/llm
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/python3 -m llama_cpp.server --model /opt/llm/models/orca-mini-3b.gguf --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --n_ctx 2048 --n_gpu_layers 0
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

# T11: No authentication, T13: API allows model extraction
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable llm-service
systemctl start llm-service

# Wait for service to start
sleep 10

# Test the service
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":5}' || true

echo "LLM service started" >> /var/log/llm-startup.log

instances.user_data:
#!/bin/bash
# User data script for Database & Cache Instance
# Runs PostgreSQL and Redis in Docker containers
# THREAT INJECTION: T01, T03, T07, T08, T10

set -e

echo "Starting database and cache setup..."

# Update system
yum update -y

# Install Docker
amazon-linux-extras install docker -y
systemctl start docker
systemctl enable docker

# T08: Password in environment variable
export POSTGRES_PASSWORD="insecure_password_123"

echo "Starting PostgreSQL and Redis containers..."

# Run PostgreSQL in Docker
# T03: No SSL/TLS encryption
# T08: Weak password
# T10: No resource limits
docker run -d \
  --name postgres \
  --restart always \
  -p 5432:5432 \
  -e POSTGRES_DB=quay \
  -e POSTGRES_USER=quayuser \
  -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=insecure_password_123 \
  -v postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data \
  postgres:14

# Run Redis in Docker
# T01: No authentication (no requirepass)
# T03: No TLS
# T10: No resource limits
docker run -d \
  --name redis \
  --restart always \
  -p 6379:6379 \
  redis:7-alpine \
  redis-server --appendonly yes

# Wait for services to start
sleep 10

# Verify containers are running
docker ps

# T07: No logging to CloudWatch
echo "Database and cache services started" >> /var/log/database-startup.log

instances.user_data:
#!/bin/bash
# User data script for Quay Application Servers
# Instance: quay-app-2
# THREAT INJECTION: T06, T08

set -e

echo "Starting Quay application setup on quay-app-2..."

# Update system
yum update -y

# Install Docker
amazon-linux-extras install docker -y
systemctl start docker
systemctl enable docker

# T08: Credentials in environment variables and logs
export DB_HOST="10.0.0.76"
export DB_PASSWORD="insecure_password_123"
export REDIS_HOST="10.0.0.76"
export MINIO_HOST="10.0.0.21"
export S3_BUCKET="quay-minimal-storage-b8clj253"
export AWS_REGION="us-east-1"

# T08: Credentials logged to system logs
echo "Starting Quay with DB_HOST=$DB_HOST on quay-app-2" >> /var/log/quay-startup.log

# Pull Quay image
docker pull quay.io/projectquay/quay:latest

# Create config directory
mkdir -p /opt/quay/config

# T08: Write config with embedded credentials
cat > /opt/quay/config/config.yaml <<EOF
FEATURE_USER_CREATION: true
FEATURE_ANONYMOUS_ACCESS: true  # T05

# Database
DB_URI: postgresql://quayuser:insecure_password_123@10.0.0.76:5432/quay  # T08
DB_CONNECTION_ARGS:
  autorollback: true
  threadlocals: true

# Redis
BUILDLOGS_REDIS:
  host: 10.0.0.76
  port: 6379
  # T01: No password

USER_EVENTS_REDIS:
  host: 10.0.0.76
  port: 6379

# Storage
DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_CONFIG:
  default:
    - S3Storage
    - s3_bucket: quay-minimal-storage-b8clj253
      storage_path: /datastorage/registry
      s3_access_key: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE  # T08: Fake but hardcoded
      s3_secret_key: wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY
      host: http://10.0.0.21:9000  # T03: HTTP
      s3_region: us-east-1

DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_DEFAULT_LOCATIONS: []
DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_PREFERENCE:
  - default

# T07: Audit logging disabled
FEATURE_AUDIT_LOG: false

FEATURE_SECURITY_SCANNER: true
SECURITY_SCANNER_ENDPOINT: http://10.0.0.21:6060  # T03: HTTP

# T03: HTTP instead of HTTPS
PREFERRED_URL_SCHEME: http
SERVER_HOSTNAME: quay-registry.local

# T02: Excessive permissions
FEATURE_DIRECT_LOGIN: true
FEATURE_NONSUPERUSER_TEAM_SYNCING_SETUP: true
EOF

# T10: No resource limits on Docker container
# Run Quay
docker run -d \
  --name quay \
  --restart always \
  -p 8080:8080 \
  -v /opt/quay/config:/conf/stack:Z \
  quay.io/projectquay/quay:latest

# Wait for Quay to start
sleep 30

# T07: No CloudWatch logging agent
echo "Quay application server quay-app-2 started" >> /var/log/quay-startup.log
